issues.t: Upper ball joint wear and separation (recall 04V-596)
issues.sym: A clunk from the front end over bumps, loose or wandering steering, and in the worst case a front wheel that suddenly tucks in.
issues.why: Water can get into the front upper ball joints, push out the grease and corrode them. The worn joint can eventually pull apart.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If the front end clunks or the steering feels loose, have the ball joints inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Exterior lights can fail from timer module fault (recall 02V-322)
issues.sym: Headlights or other exterior lights stop working or act erratically.
issues.why: A fault in the central timer module, which controls the lights, can shut them off.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and avoid night driving until the lights work reliably.

issues.t: Windshield wiper motor can quit (recall 04V-216)
issues.sym: The wipers slow down, stop partway, or stop working in the rain.
issues.why: The wiper module motor can fail, leaving the driver without clear vision.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the wiper motor replaced if it is open.

issues.t: Power outlet connector short and fire risk (recall 06V-339)
issues.sym: A hot plastic or burning smell near the power outlets, or an outlet that stops working.
issues.why: High resistance can build up in the power outlet wiring connector and overheat it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall. If you smell burning plastic, stop using the outlets and have the wiring inspected right away.

issues.t: Instrument panel fire risk from gauge cluster circuit (recalls 03V-528, 07V-092)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from behind the dash, flickering dash or interior lights, or a gauge cluster that goes dark.
issues.why: A circuit inside the instrument cluster that powers the interior lights can overheat. An earlier recall on 2004 models addressed a cracked part on the same circuit board.
issues.next: Check the VIN for both recalls. If you smell burning from the dash, pull over, shut the vehicle off and have it towed for inspection.

issues.t: Battery cable can chafe and short (recall 04V-578)
issues.sym: A burning smell under the hood, a sudden loss of electrical power, or a no-start.
issues.why: A battery cable can rub against nearby parts until its insulation wears through and it shorts, which can start an under-hood fire.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the cable routing inspected if it is open.

issues.t: Throttle cable can stick open (recall 04V-020)
issues.sym: The engine keeps revving or the vehicle keeps pulling after you lift off the gas pedal.
issues.why: The throttle control cable can bind so the throttle does not return to idle.
issues.next: If the throttle sticks, shift to neutral, brake firmly and pull over. Check the VIN for the recall before driving again.

issues.t: Vehicle may roll away in Park (recall 05V-460)
issues.sym: The vehicle creeps or rolls after being shifted into Park, especially on a slope.
issues.why: A cup plug inside the automatic transmission can come loose and keep the park mechanism from holding.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for the recall right away.

issues.t: ABS control module needs reprogramming (recall 05V-554)
issues.sym: ABS or brake warning lights, or unusual brake or stability behavior.
issues.why: A software fault in the anti-lock brake module could affect vehicle control without warning.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the module reprogrammed before relying on the vehicle in slippery conditions.

issues.t: Rear Watts link can fail (recall 06V-240)
issues.sym: A clunk from the rear suspension, or the rear end feeling loose or shifting side to side.
issues.why: A part of the rear Watts link suspension, which keeps the axle centered, can fail and affect handling.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the rear suspension inspected before highway driving.

issues.t: Windshield wiper motor can stop working (recall 06V-067)
issues.sym: The wipers stop working in some conditions.
issues.why: The front wiper motor can lose its ability to wipe, which blocks the driver's view in bad weather.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and have the wiper motor replaced if it is open.

issues.t: Fuel pump relay failure in the power module (recalls)
issues.sym: The engine cranks but won't start, or it stalls while driving.
issues.why: The fuel pump relay inside the under-hood power module (TIPM) can fail. Several recalls cover affected vehicles, including a follow-up for some that already had the first fix.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the power module inspected if the vehicle stalls or won't start.

issues.t: Brake booster corrosion (recalls)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal that takes more effort to stop the vehicle, especially in freezing weather.
issues.why: Water can get into the brake booster and corrode it, reducing power assist. The water can also freeze inside it. Recalls added a shield and later rechecked it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recalls and have the brakes inspected right away if the pedal feels hard.

issues.t: Alternator failure (recalls)
issues.sym: A battery or charging warning light, dimming lights, a burning smell, and then a sudden stall.
issues.why: The alternator can fail internally without warning. On some vehicles a failing alternator can also short and start a fire.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Get to safety and have the charging system tested if the battery light comes on.

issues.t: Left cylinder head valve seat problem (warranty extension)
issues.sym: A ticking noise from the engine, a rough idle or misfire, and a check engine light, usually pointing to cylinder 2.
issues.why: A valve seat in the left cylinder head could wear or loosen on some early Pentastar engines. Chrysler extended the warranty on the left head for affected vehicles.
issues.next: Have the misfire diagnosed soon and ask the dealer whether the head warranty extension applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Oil filter housing and oil cooler leaks
issues.sym: Oil pooling at the back of the engine, a burning oil smell, coolant loss, or oil and coolant mixing.
issues.why: The plastic oil filter housing that also holds the oil cooler can crack or its gaskets can leak after many heat cycles.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed and the housing replaced. Do not let oil drip onto hot exhaust parts.

issues.t: Lifter and camshaft wear
issues.sym: A ticking sound that does not go away when warm, misfires, a rough idle and a check engine light.
issues.why: Lifters can stop rolling and wear the camshaft lobes. It is widely reported and was the subject of a lawsuit, but there is no recall.
issues.next: Have a ticking Hemi checked quickly. Early repair limits the damage to the camshaft.

issues.t: ABS module fault (recalls)
issues.sym: ABS and stability control warning lights, brake lights that stay on, or the shifter leaving Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: The anti-lock brake module can develop a fault that affects several systems. A later recall replaced the earlier fix.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have it repaired soon.

issues.t: Steering rack can bind (recall 22V-154)
issues.sym: Steering feels stiff, sticky or notchy, especially at low speed.
issues.why: The steering rack bar may not have been properly hardened, which can cause binding. Dealers replace the steering gear.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recall and stop driving if the steering becomes hard to turn.

issues.t: Rear spoiler can crack and come loose (recalls)
issues.sym: Rubbing or a gap at the roof spoiler when the liftgate opens, or cracked spoiler edges.
issues.why: The rear spoiler may sit out of line with the roof, so the liftgate hits it when opened. A damaged spoiler can fly off on the road.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the recalls and have a cracked spoiler repaired before highway driving.

issues.t: Fuel tank strap can separate (recall 99V-342)
issues.sym: Often no warning. You may hear a clunk or scraping from under the rear of the truck, or see the fuel tank hanging low.
issues.why: A strap that holds the fuel tank can come apart, letting the tank sag or drop.
issues.next: Have this checked right away if the recall was never done. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Rear brake tube can wear through (recall 99V-341)
issues.sym: Brake fluid spots under the rear of the truck, a low or soft brake pedal, or a red brake warning light.
issues.why: A rear brake line can rub against nearby parts until it wears through and leaks fluid.
issues.next: Do not drive with a soft pedal or a brake fluid leak. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Alternator cable fastener can loosen and arc (recall 98V-019)
issues.sym: Battery light, dim lights, a burning smell or sparks under the hood.
issues.why: The nut holding the main cable to the alternator can work loose, and the loose connection can spark and overheat.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell burning or see sparks. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Clockspring can break and disable the driver airbag (recall 01V-153)
issues.sym: Airbag light stays on. The horn or steering wheel buttons may also quit.
issues.why: Material inside the steering wheel can damage the clockspring, the coiled wire that connects the airbag while the wheel turns.
issues.next: Get an airbag light checked soon, since the driver airbag may not work in a crash. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall 07V-555)
issues.sym: The shifter can be moved out of Park without your foot on the brake, sometimes with the key out.
issues.why: The lock that holds the shifter in Park can fail.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake until this is fixed, because the truck can roll away. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Transfer case may not fully engage and truck can roll (recall 01V-077)
issues.sym: On four-wheel-drive trucks, the truck may roll while the shifter is in Park.
issues.why: The transfer case can end up between gears, in a neutral spot, so Park no longer holds the wheels.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and have the recall done promptly. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Fuel filler tube valve may not close (recalls 05V-034, 09V-003)
issues.sym: Fuel smell near the rear of the truck, mostly after filling up.
issues.why: A one-way valve in the fuel filler tube may not seal fully, which could let fuel escape in a crash.
issues.next: Have it checked soon. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Airbag inflators can rupture (do-not-drive recalls)
issues.sym: Usually no warning at all before a crash.
issues.why: The driver and passenger airbag inflators can burst when the airbag fires and spray metal pieces into the cabin.
issues.next: Do not drive until the recall is completed. Dealers will tow and repair the truck for free. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

issues.t: Right steering knuckle can fracture (recall 06V-386)
issues.sym: A sudden clunk and loss of control at the right front wheel.
issues.why: The right front steering knuckle may have been made with a flaw that lets it crack.
issues.next: Have the recall checked before driving much further. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Engine computer software can briefly lock the drive wheels (recall 06V-341)
issues.sym: A sudden jolt or skid from the driven wheels, mostly when slowing down.
issues.why: A fault in the engine computer programming can make the drive wheels lock for a moment.
issues.next: Get the software update done promptly. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Rear axle pinion nut can loosen (recall 13V-038)
issues.sym: Whine, clunk or vibration from the rear axle. In the worst case the rear wheels lock up.
issues.why: The nut holding the pinion gear in the rear axle can back off, letting the gears move out of place.
issues.next: Stop driving if you hear new rear axle noise and have the recall checked. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Sun visor vanity light wiring can short (recall 14V-391)
issues.sym: Vanity mirror light quits, or a burning smell or smoke near the sun visor.
issues.why: Wiring for the lighted mirror can be pinched after headliner work and short out.
issues.next: Have it inspected soon, sooner if you smell burning. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Cruise control may not switch off (recall 18V-332)
issues.sym: Cruise control keeps holding or gaining speed even after you tap the brake or press Cancel.
issues.why: If a short happens in a certain wiring network while the truck is accelerating under cruise, the system may not shut off.
issues.next: If it happens, brake firmly and shift to Neutral, then stop. Get the software update done. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Radio software can be accessed remotely (recall 15V-461)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal use.
issues.why: A weakness in the touchscreen radio software could let an outsider reach vehicle controls.
issues.next: Have the software updated at a dealer or with the USB update from the maker.

issues.t: Left front brake caliper can crack (recall 16V-168)
issues.sym: Soft brake pedal, pull to one side when braking, or brake fluid at the left front wheel.
issues.why: The left front caliper casting may have a flaw that lets it crack.
issues.next: Do not drive with a soft pedal or fluid leak. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Rear lower control arm can fracture (recall 15V-469)
issues.sym: Clunk from the rear, the rear end feels loose or wanders.
issues.why: A rear lower control arm may not have been heat-treated correctly and can break.
issues.next: Have it replaced before driving further if the recall is open. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Fuel rail crossover tube can leak (recall 16V-814)
issues.sym: Strong raw fuel smell from under the hood.
issues.why: On some V6 engines built in early 2016 the tube that joins the two fuel rails can leak.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell fuel under the hood, because of the fire risk. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Rear axle shafts may be too short and disengage (recall 17V-541)
issues.sym: Loss of drive, or the truck rolls while in Park.
issues.why: Some rear half shafts were made too short and can slip out of the axle.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time and have the recall done promptly. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Backup camera image stays on after leaving Reverse (recall 20V-191)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture stays on the screen after you shift into Drive.
issues.why: A radio software fault keeps showing the camera image.
issues.next: Get the software update when convenient. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag fastener may be loose or missing (recall 21V-280)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you can see or hear.
issues.why: A fastener holding the side curtain airbag may be loose or missing, so the bag may not protect properly in a crash.
issues.next: Have it inspected soon. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: EGR valve can stick open and cut power (recall 22V-284)
issues.sym: Check engine light, rough running, and a sudden loss of power or stall.
issues.why: The exhaust gas recirculation valve on the V6 can stick open.
issues.next: Have it fixed promptly, since the engine can lose power in traffic. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Rearview camera image may not show (recall 24V-436)
issues.sym: Blank or frozen screen when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: A radio software fault can block the camera picture.
issues.next: Check behind you by other means and get the update soon. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Shifter may slip out of Drive (recall 22V-866)
issues.sym: The transmission drops out of Drive, or the truck is not really in Park.
issues.why: A shifter part was not hardened correctly at the factory.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time and have the recall done promptly. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Dash-mounted shifter can come out of gear (recall 23V-640)
issues.sym: On trucks with the shifter on the instrument panel, the transmission can leave the gear you chose.
issues.why: The shifter may not hold its position.
issues.next: Use the parking brake every time and have the recall done promptly. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: ABS module may switch off stability control (recall 24V-415)
issues.sym: ABS and stability control warning lights on.
issues.why: A fault in the ABS control module can disable stability control.
issues.next: Drive gently and have it fixed soon. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Tail light wiring terminals may be damaged (recall 26V-701)
issues.sym: A tail light is out or flickers, or a bulb warning shows.
issues.why: Terminals in the tail light wiring harness may have been damaged at the factory.
issues.next: Have it fixed soon so drivers behind can see you. The repair is free at a dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to see if it was already done.

issues.t: Oil sludge can choke and ruin the 4.7L V8
issues.sym: Low oil pressure or an oil light at idle, ticking from the top of the engine, loss of power, and thick black paste on the dipstick or under the oil cap.
issues.why: These engines are hard on oil and sludge builds up in the passages when oil changes are stretched or the engine runs hot. The sludge starves the camshafts and bearings.
issues.next: Stop driving if the oil light comes on and have the oil pressure checked. Short oil change intervals are the only real protection on this engine.

issues.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts tick on a cold start
issues.eng: Magnum V6 and V8, 3.7L V6, 4.7L V8
issues.sym: A tick or tap that is loudest on a cold start and fades as the engine warms, sometimes with an exhaust smell under the hood.
issues.why: The bolts that hold the exhaust manifolds to the cylinder heads snap after years of heating and cooling, and the joint then leaks.
issues.next: Have the broken bolts and gasket replaced. A leaking manifold upsets the oxygen sensor readings and can let fumes reach the cabin.

issues.t: Dropped valve seat on the 3.7L V6
issues.sym: A sudden heavy misfire on one cylinder, a flashing check engine light and a big loss of power, often after the engine has been run hot.
issues.why: Overheating lets a valve seat work loose from the aluminum cylinder head. The loose seat then batters the valve and the cylinder.
issues.next: Pull over and stop driving if the check engine light flashes. Keep the cooling system healthy and never ignore a rising temperature gauge.
